description: Defines an abstract class 'SynthVoice' representing a polyphonic synthesizer voice, including methods for note management, mixing audio output, and setting amplitude and frequency scaling.

classes.name: SynthVoice
classes.description: An abstract class for a polyphonic synthesizer voice, managing state, note parameters, and providing an abstract render method for subclasses.

methods.name: noteOn
methods.description: Activates the voice with a specific note and velocity, setting amplitude accordingly.

methods.name: mix
methods.description: Mixes the output of this voice into an output buffer over multiple samples.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Abstract method to generate the current sample; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description: Checks if the voice is currently inactive.

methods.name: setAmplitude
methods.description: Sets the amplitude of the voice.

methods.name: setFrequencyScaler
methods.description: Adjusts the frequency scaler; placeholder method.
